I have updated `src.coax` so that `accept`:
- Rejects negative `epoch` or `seq` values (`epoch < 0 || seq < 0`), returning the unmodified `old` state.
- Accepts sequence 0 (and any non-negative sequence) when advancing to a higher epoch (`epoch > old.epoch`).
- Accepts strictly increasing sequences within the same epoch (`epoch == old.epoch && seq > old.seq`).
- Rejects stale epochs (`epoch < old.epoch`) and duplicate or decreasing sequences (`seq <= old.seq` when `epoch == old.epoch`), preserving `old` state.
- Preserves the existing API types and structure.
